messages:
alex_cs: heads-up: ZenPort (ZP-58) renewal popped into procurement. They want Net-60, 9-month term, and to split the invoice between ZenPort US and ZenPort EU. Procurement attached a PO but EU VAT on the cert doesn't match the entity name on the PO. they also require customer-managed KMS onboarding. need legal + finance confirm if single SOW signed by US entity + two invoices is okay.

tanya_fin: PO number? send the PO pdf. finance can't map the EU VAT until the legal name matches vendor table. Net-60 is ok after credit check, but mark AR risk. we prefer separate invoice numbers for reconciliation.

alex_cs: PO: ZP-PO-2026-5503. snippet: ```PO: ZP-PO-2026-5503\nAmount: $84,000 (split 55/45 US/EU)\nTerm: 9 months\nBilling: Net 60\nKMS: customer-managed (will provide ARN)```

igor_legal: generally fine for US entity to sign master SOW and addendum that documents invoice split. must include carveouts for EU tax liabilities + indemnity. if customer refuses addendum we may require EU signature. i'll draft addendum language.

devon_enable: enablement flag: scheduled week-of-7/11. if billing delays push beyond 7/1 we might need to slip training by one week. i'll prepare acceptance checklist now so finance has evidence for go-live.

tanya_fin: finance needs scanned VAT cert that matches exact legal name used on PO or a signed vendor affidavit. until then EU invoice on hold. i can provision US vendor code once addendum is accepted.

alex_cs: pinged procurement for corrected VAT cert and signed confirmation of who has authority to sign for EU. asked them to confirm whether they accept addendum only or need dual signatures.

igor_legal: drafting addendum: includes invoice split clause, KMS responsibilities (customer provides key ARN and Redwood test window), acceptance criteria for enablement, and EU tax indemnity. will send to alex for customer review.

docusign-bot: DocuSign envelope 'ZenPort_SOW_Addendum_v1' prepared and awaiting attachments: 'PO_ZP-PO-2026-5503', 'VAT_cert_EU'.

alex_cs: procurement replied: "Attached updated VAT cert and corporate attestation. ZenPort EU will not sign; US signs master SOW + addendum. Confirmed split 55/45." forwarding to finance.

tanya_fin: received VAT cert and attestation. vendor mapping updated for EU. we can issue US invoice now; EU invoice will be issued after countersigned addendum is returned. removing initial hold on US invoice. marking account health: yellow (risk moderate due to Net-60 + split billing).

igor_legal: addendum ready. language allows single-signature flow with split invoices and EU indemnity clause. uploaded to DocuSign.

docusign-bot: Envelope 'ZenPort_SOW_Addendum_v1' sent to primary signee.

devon_enable: once signed we'll lock enablement date. i'll keep training team on standby.

alex_cs: great — i'll watch for the countersign and then hand off to AR + enablement. will escalate to AM if not signed by Thu COB. keeping thread open. :white_check_mark:
